name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response aligns with the given context and follows logically from the previous conversation turns.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses how interesting or engaging the continuation is, potentially prompting further interaction or discussion.

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and consistency within the response and with the overall conversation.

name: Use of Provided Fact
description: Determines the extent to which the contestant effectively incorporates the given interesting fact into the conversation.
scale: Not Used, Partially Used, Fully Integrated

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and creativity of the response, considering how uniquely or inventively the contestant continues the conversation.
